# Membership summary

Members must provide a notice period of forty-five (45) days when terminating their membership, counted from the day the written notice is received [[cite:obs-c5fcc45b8f2cb18550d25e16e1fbe1146f455e4b "Members may terminate their membership in writing. The expense approval threshold is 500 EUR per single expense, effective from 1 October 2026 [[cite:obs-cedf7e8021488cbc25caccb03a644fa3963185d3 "With effect from 1 October 2026 the expense approval threshold is 500 EUR per single expense."]].
